title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding transforms categorical variables into a set of binary variables. For the 'sex' column, each unique value ('male' and 'female') becomes a separate column in the design matrix.

title: Structure of the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix \( \Phi_1 \) will have the same number of rows as the original dataset. Consider how many rows are in the dataset based on the problem description.
